description: For a complete consistent Henkin set \(S\), \(\exists x\,\varphi(x)\in S\) if and only if \(\varphi(t)\in S\) for some closed term \(t\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.ex_mem_iff.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {S : Set (L.Formula ℕ)}
  (hS : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Consistent S)
  (hC : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.Complete S)
  (hH : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.Henkin S) (φ : L.BoundedFormula ℕ 1) :
  φ.ex ∈ S ↔ ∃ t, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.instantiate φ t ∈ S
